scope: One strength and one tradeoff for exactly 24 recommended current-linked Australian truck configurations; source-level draft, no app edits.

countingPolicy.hyundai: One 7,300 kg bare cab chassis; lower 4,495/4,500 kg conflict and body options do not add records

measurementCohorts.vehicleClass: truck only; do not rank with passenger cars or vans
measurementCohorts.mass: Exact rating minus corresponding bare-chassis mass only. Estimated masses remain estimated. Published completed-body figures retain their stated and unknown treatment of occupants/accessories.
measurementCohorts.range: No normalized cross-cycle comparison. Only F3E Tray/Cargo Box declared WLTP comparison is used in lead copy; test payload unspecified. JAC C-WTVC, Hyundai local loaded-tray test and Foton unspecified-cycle claims are separate.
measurementCohorts.battery: Declared capacity only; no usable/gross conversion or battery-to-range calculation.
measurementCohorts.dimensions: Only corresponding labelled wheelbase, cab-chassis length, body height and kerb-to-kerb diameter. No generic overall width or swept-path inference.
measurementCohorts.charging: Vehicle maximum kW distinct from station rating, cable rating and charge-time SOC window.

All factual dependencies of comparisons include both exact configurations, with arithmetic recorded. Context dependencies preserve unknowns/conflicts as restrictions, never as proof a feature is absent.
If any fact used in either clause is missing, changes, conflicts or loses its qualifying conditions/source support, fail closed for that clause rather than filling gaps from family siblings.
Unresolved context such as H9E AC power remains visible; do not invent a positive/negative capability merely to fit runtime guards.
